comment: tier1_size = how many of the most common Danish words get AI examples and gotcha notes. Raise this number and re-run scripts/enrich.py + scripts/build_xml.py to expand coverage.

comment_sources: Builds use the pinned copies (pinned_url, checked against sha256) so a release is reproducible and data/curated/fixes.json always matches the data it was written for. To move to newer upstream data: python3 scripts/fetch_data.py --latest, rebuild, fix any 'fixes matched nothing' warnings, upload the files as a new sources-YYYY-MM-DD release and update pinned_url/sha256 here.
comment_form_entries: Inflected forms (sagde, gik, husene…) that get a small entry of their own, so the Look Up popup underlines the form that was selected: a list of forms, or "all" for every form of a common word (scripts/parse_sources.py FORM_ENTRY_MAX_RANK).
